title: SDK parity fixes (blank_id null, TS fuzz mismatches)
notes: Follow-up of M7-07. blank_id null = no blank class (spec 3.1; it was always valid): the reference greedy decoder (trust/_ctc.py find_segments) raised IndexError on the FEP-0002 frames route; now every frame is a token frame and each run of equal argmax frames is one token (same rule as eval.metrics.ctc_greedy_ids). Spec text: v0.1 3.1 blank_id row + changelog row; FEP-0002 section 10 (MUST NOT reject; vector L32). New golden vector fep-0002 L32 (l32-frames-no-blank.json, accept, final_decisions 1). Rust: check in StructuralLayer::end removed. TS: string-stream samples iterated after the empty-timestamps check; consumer_settings via pyDict (Python dict(x or {})); gap length via pyRoundInt (half to even, error on inf/NaN; 4th gap found at seed 5). Parity: Python = TS = Rust on 168/168 vectors and 24,396/24,396 fuzz mutants (seeds 1-6, --n 30; v0.1 3,516, fep-0001 7,200, fep-0002 5,760, fep-0003 7,920). CI fuzz raised from --n 10 (1 seed) to --n 30 at seeds 1-3 (about 16 s per seed locally). Test tests/test_ctc_no_blank.py.
